Matrix value helpers

Source: R/matrix-values.R
anndata-matrix-values.Rd

Internal helpers for the array values held in X, layers, obsm, varm, obsp and varp. Accepted values are base matrix or array (double, integer or logical), dgCMatrix/lgCMatrix (CSC) and dgRMatrix/lgRMatrix (CSR). Other Matrix classes are coerced, sparse to CSC and dense to base matrix.

Usage

as_anndata_matrix(
  x,
  allow_array = FALSE,
  what = "value",
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

matrix_dim(x)

matrix_subset(x, i = NULL, j = NULL)

matrix_transpose(x)

Arguments

x

A matrix-like value.

allow_array

Whether arrays with more than 2 dimensions are accepted.

what

Description of the value used in error messages.

call

The call reported by errors.

i, j

Integer positions (1-based) on the first and second dimension, or NULL to keep that dimension whole.

Details

The On-disk dtype record is the anndata_dtype attribute. The helpers copy it onto every result that keeps the values.
